subject: general
question: Choose the antonym of 'ascend':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Descend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ascend"** means to move upward, rise, or climb something physically or metaphorically. (ऊपर उठना या चढ़ना)

 
 
• **Example:** The hiker started to ascend the mountain early in the morning.
 
 
 
• **"Descend"** refers to moving downward, coming or going lower, or sinking from a higher position to a lower one. (नीचे उतरना)
 
 
• **Example:** After reaching the peak, they began to descend the mountain cautiously.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ascend'** is **'descend'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Descend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rise **(उठना): To move upward, increase, or go higher.

 
 
• **Example:** The sun will rise early tomorrow morning.
 
 
 
• **Soar **(ऊंची उड़ान भरना): To fly or rise high in the air quickly or effortlessly.
 
 
• **Example:** The eagle soared high above the valley.
 
 
 
• **Climb **(चढ़ाई करना): To go upward, especially by using hands and feet.
 
 
• **Example:** The child managed to climb the tree with great effort.
 
 

159:T872,
The correct answer is Option 3
